subject: english
stem: Five people have a large box. The lift sign counts people only. Can all five ride together?
options: Yes, five is below the six-person limit
No, because the box is a sixth person
No, because seven people are shown
Yes, because there is no limit

optionRationales.reason: Yes, five is below the six-person limit：图示五人与 MAX 6 PEOPLE；题干说明 box 不计人数。
No, because the box is a sixth person：题干说 counts people only。
No, because seven people are shown：图中只有五人。
Yes, because there is no limit：图明确 MAX 6。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「圖形提供的非文字關係與題幹條件合併後得到唯一情境」可推出 Yes, five is below the six-person limit；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Yes, five is below the six-person limit 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
